source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for October 26 to 30
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 23, 2026 · 18 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! The Séance of Blake Manor Raw Fury ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now The Séance of Blake Manor – October 27Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere It is October 28th, 1897, and Private Investigator Declan Ward arrives at Blake Manor to find a missing woman. What he finds is the Grand Séance and a group of mystics who have gathered from all corners of the world – waiting for All Hallow’s Eve, the night when the veil between worlds is thinnest. The night to tear down the barrier and speak to the dead. Interview and interrogate your suspects, keep a record of all evidence, motivations, and clues in your journal, and confront them about their motivations when you’re certain of your deductions. Uncover the truth about Blake Manor and the mysterious séance that has brought everyone together. Mouthwashing CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $12.99 Pre-order Mouthwashing – October 29XBOX Play Anywhere Mouthwashing is a first-person horror game following the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter. Who could have known what good ol’ Captain Curly was capable of? Guess he thought his crew dying alongside him was only right. But some men can’t even kill themselves properly. Maimed, limbless and unable to speak, but alive, Curly is now at the mercy of the crew he has doomed to a slow death. The Wolf Among Us Remastered Telltale ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now The Wolf Among Us Remastered – October 29 Fairy tales are real. Murder is just the beginning. Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered – the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before – honoring the original experience while introducing Fabletown to a new generation of players. Queen's Domain Future Friends Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $19.99 $16.99 Pre-order Queen’s Domain – October 30 Queen’s Domain is a retro-fantasy action RPG. Washed up on the shores of the Isle of Neasied, you set out to find your father and uncover the dark heart of this mysterious isle. Wield the Legendary Holy Sword Endu to take flight from platform to platform, and discover an interconnected, labyrinthine world where secrets and dangers lurk around every corner. Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) Funktronic Labs ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Scramble Knights Online (Game Preview) – October 26Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Scramble Knights Online, an MMO-lite adventure! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracott! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training. Terrible Lizards Digital Pajamas ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Terrible Lizards – October 29Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Something is very wrong at Dalton’s Dinos, the once must-see Route 66 roadside attraction baking under the New Mexico sun. The staff have vanished, but a mysterious voice on the telephone you find in the attraction begs you for help to find a missing child. You’d leave… if your car hadn’t died miles from anywhere. It’s 1992. No cell phones. No rideshares. No help coming, and you’ll soon find that you are not alone inside the attraction. Ayasa: Shadows of Silence Aya Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – October 26 Step into the eerie world of Ayasa, a dark tale that blends quests, horror, and puzzles into a haunting journey. Without a single spoken word, the story is told through pantomime, surreal imagery, and a soundtrack composed by Komitas. You will navigate six symbolic lands Faith, Hope, Love, Greed, Indifference, and Betrayal—each corrupted by darkness. Every choice you make, every act of compassion or indifference, may lead to an unexpected ending. Will you restore balance or become the very force you sought to defeat? PAO PAO (Game Preview) Dreland Enterprises ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now PAO PAO – October 26 Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services Destroyer Doggo ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services – October 27XBOX Play Anywhere Welcome to Bao Bao’s Cozy Cleaning Services, where things don’t need to be perfect — just a little cleaner, a little calmer, and a little more you. Whether you’re curled up with a podcast or just need something peaceful to help the world feel quieter, this gentle 2D pressure washing game is here for you. No timers, no stress, just pastel pixel art, soft sounds, and the satisfying swish of clean water. Bloom Busters UBrothers ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Bloom Busters – October 27Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Bloomland is under attack. A toxic infestation has twisted its gardens and filled them with cheeky mutated creatures – and Jimmy and Jessie are ready to clean up the mess. Bloom Busters is a frantic, old-school action arcade adventure with a distinctive isometric perspective. Play solo or team up in two-player local co-op as you bash and blast through handcrafted levels. Master wild weapons ranging from the trusty Fly Swatter and Grandpa’s Club to the gooey Slime Gun. Cozy Radiation Cleaner SilverSet Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now Cozy Radiation Cleaner – October 27 Cozy Radia

Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionThis game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. WELCOME TO PAO PAO! Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. BUILD YOUR DREAM RESTAURANT Turn a small kitchen into a restaurant of your dreams. Arrange your equipment, create your menu and serve everything from simple meals to a packed house full of hungry customers. Play solo or work together with up to 4 players to keep the kitchen running and grow your restaurant. NOT ONLY ABOUT KITCHEN There’s a whole life outside the restaurant. Grow your own crops, go fishing from the shore or a boat, gather resources in the forest, take a ride around town or spend an afternoon at the arcade. When you’re done working, there’s always another way to enjoy the day. CREATE YOUR PERFECT PLACE Make PAO PAO feel like home. Customize your character, change your look on the go and decorate your house, restaurant and yard exactly how you want. Mix furniture, decorations and different styles to create a place that feels uniquely yours - from a cozy little home to a restaurant fit for a king. BRING YOUR FRIENDS ALONG PAO PAO is even better with friends. Work together in the kitchen, split up to explore different parts of town, or forget about work completely and start causing trouble. Race boats, play basketball, shoot each other with water guns, throw food around and turn an ordinary day into your own little adventure.
